title: Off-Shoulder Sheer Tiered Ruffle Maternity Robe Gown
seo_title: Sheer Tiered Ruffle Maternity Robe Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Sheer off-shoulder tulle maternity photoshoot robe gown with ruffle tiers, a front opening and a train. 5 colors, US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a sheer tulle robe gown with a ruffled off-shoulder neckline, short ruffle sleeves, an open front that shows off the bump, and bands of tiered ruffles that sweep into a train.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
sheer tulle robe style with a ruffled V-shaped off-shoulder neckline, short ruffle sleeves, a tie at the bust, an open front, bands of tiered ruffles at the hip and hem, and a sweeping train.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Sky Blue, Dusty Rose, Lilac, Black and Burgundy.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust today; the open front and loose sheer skirt leave room for the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
garment_lock: a fully sheer tulle maternity robe gown with a ruffled V-shaped off-shoulder neckline, short ruffled sleeves, a small tie at the bust, an open front, a band of three ruffle tiers at the hips and another wide band of ruffle tiers at the hem, and a wide sweeping train

Generate FOUR separate images in this order and save each into the current working directory with exactly these names:
- image1.png — IMAGE 1, MAIN HERO: a visibly pregnant woman (about 7 months) standing in a bright, softly lit photo studio with a plain light backdrop, wearing this gown, one hand on her bump, the other holding the open skirt out so the sheer tulle and the ruffle bands show; full length, front-facing, gown in sharp focus.
- image3.png — IMAGE 3, BEST OCCASION: the same woman at an outdoor maternity photoshoot in a meadow at golden hour, the sheer tulle ruffles and train moving in the breeze; full length.
- image5.png — IMAGE 5, PRODUCT-ONLY: no people. The gown displayed on a white dress form (mannequin) in a bright studio, train spread around the base, showing the ruffled off-shoulder neckline, the sheer tulle and the ruffle bands clearly.
- image6.png — IMAGE 6, ALTERNATE LIFESTYLE: the same pregnant woman on a beach at sunset with her partner (a man in a plain white shirt and beige trousers) standing behind her with his hands on her bump; she wears the gown; three-quarter length.
Do not ask me anything; continue until all four files are saved. Keep the same woman across images 1, 3 and 6.

Each output: one single vertical 9:16 photo, no collage, no borders, no text, no watermark. Crop minimally to 9:16 if needed.
PRODUCT LOCK: sky blue colour, fully sheer tulle robe gown, ruffled V-shaped off-shoulder neckline, short ruffle sleeves, open front, ruffle bands at hips and hem, sweeping train. No belt, no sequins. No logos, no letters, no extra embellishment.
MODEL STYLE: a natural-looking European woman, fair to light-medium skin, warm smile, tasteful and elegant; a different woman from the reference photos.
STRICT QUALITY CHECK before saving: reject and regenerate if the gown design or colour changed, the sheer tulle or the ruffle bands are missing, she does not look pregnant, extra text appears, it is a collage, not 9:16, or it looks fake.
When all four files are saved, reply with one line per file: name, width x height.
